### 🎫 Change Policy for Your Business Class Ticket (BK-B70889)

**Since you're flying Business class, changes to your booking — including seat assignment modifications — are free of charge.** There is no change fee for Business class tickets.

| Policy Point | Details |
|---|---|

### For reference, here's how change fees work across cabin classes:

| Cabin Class | Change Fee |
|---|---|

| Economy (>7 days before departure) | $75 domestic / $100 international |
| Economy (≤7 days before departure) | $150 domestic / $200 international |
| Basic Economy | Not changeable after the free window |

**Special circumstances** (medical, bereavement, jury duty, military, weather, or airline schedule changes) may qualify for reduced or waived fees on Economy tickets as well.

---
